interpretation.channels: Four distinct decoded channels are available in one MediaElementAudioSourceNode; one tested native video needs no parallel audio player for separate group controls.
interpretation.gain: At 1x, source amplitudes approximately .04FS become .02FS at half gain, while the muted group is below .001FS in the stereo graph output.
interpretation.transport: Native pause/seek, loop, reload and persistent-element layout movement passed. All four graph channels retained signal at every tested rate.
interpretation.rates: The latest matched comparison passed presented-frame advancement at 0.25x, 0.5x, 1x, 2x, 4x and 8x both before creating the audio-source node and with the control graph. The earlier unpaired 4x/8x failure remains recorded; its cause is unresolved. This single bounded comparison is not a sustained stability or production performance claim.
interpretation.clock: Numeric Web Audio graph observations do not establish physical audible A/V latency, current production controller behavior or capture-time alignment.
